source: IAPWS Wagner-Pruss auxiliary saturation; NIST H2O(g) Shomate; Watson latent heat

liquid.source: IAPWS SR6-08(2011), equation 7 and table 5; coefficients converted from microPa.s to Pa.s. https://iapws.org/technical-guidance/release/LiquidWater.download . Includes metastable liquid below freezing and above boiling at 0.1 MPa; this is not a phase-stability model.

sublimation_pressure.source: IAPWS R14-08(2011), Revised Release on the Pressure along the Melting and Sublimation Curves of Ordinary Water Substance, equation 6 with table 3: ln(p_sub/p_t) = (T_t/T) sum a_i (T/T_t)^b_i at the triple point of the ice record (273.16 K, 611.657 Pa); free release https://iapws.org; its check value 8.94735 Pa at 230 K reproduced (tools/unified-thermo-port-ice/fit). The free-water rule scales it to meet the liquid's saturation pressure on the melting line (FreeWaterIce).
